Page uses global recent 50 rows, not selected-entry audit; foreground polling, clamped limit and AbortSignal. Hook also supports GET /system/dlq/{id}/audit registered at router line 4455, but this page does not call it.

Existing live-mode-only mutation; sudo and IP throttling in router, server replay gate. Invalidates system/dlq queries; cancellation silent, 403 page banner, other errors toast. Never invoked during audit.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local formatBytes duplicates lib/numberFormat.ts:163, stops at MB, while shared formatter handles GB and explicit precision/locale. Entry table and operational brief should not establish competing byte formatting.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse shared formatBytes with current preferences and preserve invalid-negative handling, raw bytes and exact table/export semantics.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Page hero stacks below xl, uses min-w-0 and full-width shared layout. Drawer is full width below sm, constrained at sm with fixed footer and internal scrolling. Payload pre has bounded overflow.

issues.detail: mobileColumns exposes only replayed_at, actor and result. DataTable.tsx:237-245 explicitly hides other columns below md. AuditPanel supplies no row-detail action or mobilePresentation, so DLQ ID, destination, error and trace are not available in this mobile row presentation. EntriesTable.tsx:191 similarly prioritizes three columns, but its Inspect drawer recovers metadata unlike the audit panel.
issues.fix: Adopt existing DataTable mobilePresentation/full-detail contract for audit rows while preserving all fields, filters, loaded/selected exports and stable table IDs. Verify real controls and column-menu behavior before asserting recovery.

sourcePositives: EntriesTable.tsx:162 has localized unique row inspect names.
EntryDrawer uses shared dialog and localized payload tab names; loading blocks provide status and aria-busy.
Tabs.tsx provides keyboard roving focus, arrows, Home/End and 44px minimum targets.
ReasonBreakdown exposes labeled list and textual counts/percentages; badges include textual outcome codes.

issues.detail: Tabs renders aria-controls using its generated prefix (Tabs.tsx:109-119), but EntryDrawer does not pass idBase and its tabpanel at lines 255-262 has neither matching id nor aria-labelledby. The controls therefore reference absent panel identities.
issues.fix: Use React useId as stable idBase and wire active panel id and aria-labelledby to the current Tabs naming contract; retain tabs, content, copy action and keyboard behavior.

states.initial: Summary, reason breakdown and drawer have contextual skeletons. Entries/audit tables use loading empty-message text rather than contextual table skeletons.
states.empty: Source-confirmed empty table, reason and audit messages; unselected drawer EmptyState.
states.fatal: List and audit use deriveDataState fatalError and QueryError retry independently.
states.retained: List/audit retained data remain visible on refresh failure; PageContainer/DataSourceNotice reports source degradation. Summary displays explicit retained text on list.isError.
states.offline: Shared source notice and request guards exist; lazy entry read is omitted from page dataSources and receives no error/paused contract.

issues.detail: Drawer gets data and isLoading only, not entry.error, fetchStatus, trust state or retry. EntryDrawer.tsx:162-178 treats missing/empty decoded payload as non-UTF-8 data with summary byte count; CopyButton receives empty text when full data is absent. Failed, disabled or paused entry loads can look like measured binary payload rather than unavailable details. This is especially relevant to ID-01.
issues.fix: Pass existing derived entry DataState and refetch to drawer; distinguish initial, paused/unavailable, fatal and retained refresh error without deleting summary, metadata, real binary fallback or independent page panels.

issues.detail: decodeBase64Utf8 returns empty string both for an empty decoded payload and failure; truthiness fallback labels a valid zero-byte UTF-8 payload as non-UTF-8 binary. Missing full details also shares this branch.
issues.fix: Represent decode outcomes explicitly as missing, valid text (including empty) or opaque binary, preserving base64 copy for actual binary data.

visualIssues.detail: All three decorative panel action icons use fixed text-cyan-300 (also lines 165,183) rather than theme-aware neutral hierarchy. No neon/glow source matches were found in bounded production feature files; rendered intensity/contrast are not proven.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/semantic text tokens for non-action icons; keep real warning/error meaning and all saved palette choices.

visualIssues.detail: Shared Drawer side, header and tab borders use fixed border-white/[0.06] (also lines 138,194) while footer uses border-default. This is a theme consistency risk, not measured contrast failure.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should map those borders to existing semantic surface/border tokens without changing overlay geometry, scroll, focus or saved settings.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-046 source identity / typed API contract
architectureIssues.detail: Frontend DTO DLQEntrySummary.id is number (types/admin-diagnostics.ts:87) and useDLQEntry requires positive integers, replacing other values with 0 and disabling the query. Actual handler DLQEntrySummary.ID is string (internal/api/dlq/handler.go:53), and MQTT inspector declares a random 128-bit hex string at dlq_inspector.go:91-94. A real selected string ID therefore cannot enable the full-payload read. Replay DTO replayed_id and audit response dlq_id also disagree with handler strings; scoped audit hook rejects strings.
architectureIssues.fix: Align DLQ opaque IDs and query-key/path/scoped-audit contracts with actual string source identity across the DTO and hook integration. Encode path segments, preserve numeric database audit-row IDs separately, existing keys' purpose, lazy loading and gates. Add source-realistic string-ID regressions before page migration; never invent numeric coercion.
